Subject: Request: cross-region KEK rotation forensics and CAIQ mapping

Hi Karthik,

We are preparing for our upcoming SIG/CAIQ review and need a compact forensic package for the KEK rotation that occurred across us-east-1 and us-west-2 on 2027-08-29. Specifically we need:

- Rotation timeline (who initiated, who approved, exact timestamps).
- Signed operator acknowledgements for the rotation step where the KEK wrap keys were re-wrapped.
- Transport/envelope wrapping traces showing cross-region handoff.
- Mapping of each artifact to CAIQ/SOC 2 control statements (where to reference in our CAIQ spreadsheet).

Please send a single secure-transfer link with the logs and a short narrative (1 page) that we can attach to the evidence bundle. If you foresee any retention or redaction concerns please flag them up front — compliance needs to know whether any items are redacted for privacy.

Thanks,
Julia Ramos
Senior Security Architect — AuroraFin
security@aurorafin.com

Julia —

Thanks for the clear list. We can produce a compact forensic bundle that covers the points you listed. Quick plan:

1) Ben will extract the operator audit traces and create the signed acknowledgements (PDF).
2) Marissa will assemble the envelope wrapping trace and the cross-region transfer timeline.
3) I will map artifacts to CAIQ and SOC 2 control statements and produce a 1-page narrative and control-index sheet.

We have a few constraints to call out: internal operator identifiers are pseudonymized in exported operator transcripts for privacy (we will include mapping to role, shift, and redaction justification). Key material is never exported — traces will be limited to wrapping metadata, timestamps, and checksums.

Deliverables (target): rotation-ops-log-20270911.csv, envelope-wrap-trace-09-11.txt, signed-rotation-ack.pdf, soc2-caiq-reference-mapping.xlsx, and a 1-page narrative. I will deliver via secure transfer by Monday 2027-09-13 EOD PT. If you need an earlier window for an Escalation call let us know.
